payload.core_mechanism_summary: Observe that any subarray of length ≥5 always contains a bad triple, so only check length-3 and length-4 subarrays for monotonic triples, counting good ones in O(n).
payload.rationale: The solution uses a mathematical bound to restrict search to very short subarrays, then enumerates them with a simple condition check, akin to branch-and-bound pruning.
